title: Mpox Airborne Transmission: A Systematic Review.
abstract: Since May 2022, mpox has been reported across multiple nonendemic regions, with concurrent outbreaks in diverse geographic settings, raising concerns about broader international spread. However, evidence regarding the risk of airborne transmission remains limited. We conducted a systematic review to evaluate the risk of airborne transmission and the presence of viable viruses in air samples. PubMed, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies published in English, including environmental studies, case reports, cross-sectional studies, and cohort studies. Data extraction included study characteristics (authors, year, design, and setting), sample size, diagnostic methods, participant characteristics, follow-up, type of respiratory particles assessed (droplets and/or aerosols), and key findings. Of 286 records identified, four studies met the inclusion criteria. All were environmental studies published between 2022 and 2023. MPXV DNA was detected in surface and air samples, with cycle threshold (Ct) values ranging from < 30 to < 45. However, none of the studies demonstrated consistent viral viability in aerosols or droplets sufficient to support airborne transmission. Overall, the available evidence is limited and does not support a clear risk of airborne infection. Further well-designed studies in human settings are needed to clarify the potential for mpox transmission through respiratory routes. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: PROSPERO: CRD42023391123.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对猴痘的空气传播传播的风险进行了系统评价,包括2022年至2023年期间发表的环境研究、病例报告、横断面研究和队列研究研究。
elements_zh.methods: 该综述涉及搜索 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Cochrane 图书馆以英文发表的研究,提取有关研究特征、样本量、诊断方法、参与者特征、评估的呼吸颗粒物和主要发现的数据。
elements_zh.main_results: 在表面和空气样本中检测到 MPXV DNA,循环阈值 (Ct) 值范围为 < 30 至 < 45。然而,没有一项研究表明气溶胶或液滴中病毒的生存能力一致,足以支持空气中的 传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,现有证据并不支持空气传播感染的明显风险,强调需要在人类环境中进行进一步精心设计的研究,以阐明 猴痘 传播 通过呼吸道途径的可能性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,目前的证据不足以证实猴痘在空气中传播,这对公共卫生措施以及制定有针对性的监测和预防策略具有影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据有限且基于环境研究,可能无法完全代表人类 传播 动态,导致结论的置信度评估适中。

title: Emerging infectious diseases (Mpox, Nipah, and Andes): A narrative review of transmission, environmental survival, and disinfection
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus are emerging infectious diseases that cause outbreaks associated with nosocomial transmission. METHODS: This narrative review summarizes the Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus epidemiology, clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment with a focus on environmental survival, susceptibility to antiseptics and disinfectants, and infection prevention. RESULTS: Mpox, Nipah virus, and Andes virus all survive in the environment and are capable of indirect transmission. All these viruses are enveloped and susceptible to commonly used antiseptics and surface disinfectants. CONCLUSIONS: Rapid identification of patients with known or suspected infections of these emerging viruses coupled with adherence to infection prevention recommendations will prevent healthcare-associated transmission.

abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒是新出现的传染病,导致与医院 传播 相关的 暴发。方法:这篇叙述性综述总结了 猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒 流行病学、临床表现、诊断 和 治疗,重点是环境生存、对防腐剂和消毒剂的敏感性以及感染预防。结果:猴痘、尼帕病毒和安第斯病毒都可以在环境中生存,并且能够间接感染 传播。所有这些病毒都有包膜,对常用的防腐剂和表面消毒剂敏感。结论:快速识别已知或疑似感染这些新出现病毒的患者,并遵守感染预防建议,将预防与医疗保健相关的 传播。

title: Molecular cloning of a monkeypox virus clade IIb genome and construction of an attenuated mutant for basic and translational research
abstract: ABSTRACT Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is a rodent-borne orthopoxvirus causing mpox disease upon zoonotic transmission to humans. Recent global outbreaks have raised awareness and highlighted the need for basic and translational research. However, research is hampered by the classification of MPXV as a Risk Group 3 pathogen. In an effort to overcome this limitation, we generated a complete full-length MPXV clade IIb bacterial artificial chromosome (BAC) clone by single-step transformation-associated recombination (STAR) cloning in yeast. The integrity of the cloned MPXV genome sequence and the replication capability of the BAC-derived virus were verified. To obtain an attenuated mutant, the viral thymidine kinase (TK) gene, OPG101, was deleted by BAC recombineering. The TK-deficient MPXV mutant replicated to similar titers as the wild-type virus in cell culture but was attenuated in vivo, as shown in the CAST/EiJ mouse intradermal infection model. The attenuated TK-deficient MPXV mutant has the potential to be classified as a Risk Group 2 pathogen by regulatory authorities. This would allow research to be conducted in Biosafety Level 2 laboratories and greatly facilitate basic and applied MPXV research. For example, we demonstrate that the TK-deficient virus can be used for the detection of neutralizing antibodies in human serum samples or for antiviral drug testing.

title: Toward Precision Vaccinology for Mpox: Rational Antigen Design, Next-Generation Platforms, and Immune Correlates of Protection
abstract: Mpox has emerged as a global public health concern, highlighting the limitations of traditional vaccinia-based vaccination strategies and the urgent need for precision vaccinology approaches. Advances in structural virology and immunoinformatics have enabled the identification of conserved immunodominant antigens from both mature virion and extracellular virion forms, supporting the development of multivalent antigen combinations capable of inducing broad neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses. Emerging delivery technologies including mRNA-lipid nanoparticles, viral vectors, and self-assembling protein nanoparticles offer rapid scalability, enhanced immunogenicity, and improved safety compared with conventional live-attenuated vaccines. Addressing antigenic evolution, vaccine supply limitations, and population-specific immune variability will be crucial for optimizing vaccine effectiveness. This review synthesizes current evidence on antigen design, vaccine delivery platforms, and immunological correlates of protection to outline a framework for next-generation mpox vaccines. Precision vaccinology therefore represents a transformative strategy for developing durable, clade-specific mpox vaccines and strengthening preparedness against future orthopoxvirus outbreaks worldwide.

Emerging delivery technologies including mRNA-lipid nanoparticles, viral vectors, and self-assembling protein nanoparticles offer rapid scalability, enhanced immunogenicity, and improved safety compared with conventional live-attenuated vaccines. Addressing antigenic evolution, vaccine supply limitations, and population-specific immune variability will be crucial for optimizing vaccine effectiveness. This review synthesizes current evidence on antigen design, vaccine delivery platforms, and immunological correlates of protection to outline a framework for next-generation mpox vaccines. Precision vaccinology therefore represents a transformative strategy for developing durable, clade-specific mpox vaccines and strengthening preparedness against future orthopoxvirus outbreaks worldwide.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the development of next-generation mpox vaccines through precision vaccinology, emphasizing the need to overcome limitations of traditional vaccinia-based strategies. It highlights advances in structural virology and immunoinformatics that have enabled the identification of conserved antigens, supporting the design of multivalent vaccines. Emerging delivery technologies, such as mRNA-lipid nanoparticles and self-assembling protein nanoparticles, are presented as promising alternatives due to their scalability, immunogenicity, and safety. The review also identifies key challenges, including antigenic evolution, vaccine supply constraints, and immune variability across populations, which must be addressed to enhance vaccine effectiveness. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 猴痘病毒(正痘病毒 猴痘)、MPXV 分支和 猴痘 疾病。它解决了对精确疫苗学方法的需求,以克服传统基于痘苗的策略的局限性,并开发 疫苗,该 疫苗 可以诱导针对不同病毒分支的广泛中和抗体反应。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述全面综合了有关抗原设计、疫苗 递送平台和保护的免疫相关性的当前证据。它包括结构病毒学和免疫信息学进展的一般背景信息,这些信息使得能够从成熟和细胞外病毒颗粒形式中鉴定保守的免疫显性抗原。该综述没有明确报告荟萃分析或共识过程,但它整合了各种研究的结果,概述了下一代 猴痘 疫苗 的框架。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,新兴的递送技术,如 mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒、病毒 媒介 和自组装蛋白纳米颗粒,在可扩展性、免疫原性和安全性方面比传统的减毒活体 疫苗 具有显着优势。这些技术被认为是开发耐用、特定进化枝 猴痘 疫苗 的有前途的工具。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该审查确定了几个证据差距,包括需要解决抗原 进化、疫苗 供应限制以及人群特异性免疫变异性,以优化 疫苗 的有效性。它还指出了了解保护的免疫相关性以指导 疫苗 开发的重要性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调了精准疫苗学在开发下一代 猴痘 疫苗 中的重要性。它建议未来的研究应集中在抗原设计、疫苗 递送平台和保护的免疫相关性上,以提高 疫苗 的有效性和针对未来 正痘病毒 暴发 的准备。

title: Association of Social Determinants of Health, Age, Sex and Sexual Exposure with HIV, Acquired Syphilis, and Mpox Detection Rates in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: An Ecological Study
abstract: Abstract This study employs a neighborhood-level Social Protection Index (SPI) to analyze how socioeconomic factors relate to the detection of HIV, acquired syphilis, and mpox. We conducted a retrospective analysis of 2022 surveillance data from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, using case notifications geolocated to neighborhoods. Population data were obtained from the 2022 census. Neighborhoods were stratified by SPI into quintiles, and detection rates per 100,000 population were calculated by sexual exposure category. Associations between age, SPI, and detection rates were analyzed using multilevel Poisson regression models with random intercepts, fitted separately for men who gave sex with men (MSM), heterosexual men and women. Of 2,876 new HIV cases, the highest detection rate was among MSM (1,522/100,000). Of 13,676 syphilis cases, the male-to-female detection ratio was 1.7:1. Of 957 mpox cases, 80% occurred among MSM (812/100,000). HIV and syphilis clustered in lower SPI neighborhoods, while mpox concentrated in higher SPI neighborhoods. For HIV, younger age showed the strongest association among MSM, while lower SPI was strongest among women. For syphilis, younger age was most important among women, with strong SPI associations in both sexes. Among MSM, mpox was concentrated in 25-39 age group and higher SPI neighborhoods. Strong socioeconomic gradients among women reflect intersecting gender and socioeconomic inequalities. Among MSM, attenuated socioeconomic gradients and distinct mpox patterns suggest social and sexual networks shape transmission alongside structural factors. Prevention must address social determinants and network structures.

Neighborhoods were stratified by SPI into quintiles, and detection rates per 100,000 population were calculated by sexual exposure category. Associations between age, SPI, and detection rates were analyzed using multilevel Poisson regression models with random intercepts, fitted separately for men who gave sex with men (MSM), heterosexual men and women. Of 2,876 new HIV cases, the highest detection rate was among MSM (1,522/100,000). Of 13,676 syphilis cases, the male-to-female detection ratio was 1.7:1. Of 957 mpox cases, 80% occurred among MSM (812/100,000). HIV and syphilis clustered in lower SPI neighborhoods, while mpox concentrated in higher SPI neighborhoods. For HIV, younger age showed the strongest association among MSM, while lower SPI was strongest among women. For syphilis, younger age was most important among women, with strong SPI associations in both sexes. Among MSM, mpox was concentrated in 25-39 age group and higher SPI neighborhoods. Strong socioeconomic gradients among women reflect intersecting gender and socioeconomic inequalities. Among MSM, attenuated socioeconomic gradients and distinct mpox patterns suggest social and sexual networks shape transmission alongside structural factors. Prevention must address social determinants and network structures.

abstract_zh: 摘要:本研究采用社区级社会保护指数 (SPI) 来分析社会经济因素与 HIV、后天梅毒和 猴痘 检测的关系。我们使用地理定位到社区的病例通知,对巴西里约热内卢的 2022 年 监测 数据进行了回顾性分析。人口数据来自 2022 年人口普查。根据 SPI 将社区分为五等分,并根据性接触类别计算每 10 万人的检出率。使用随机截距的多级泊松回归模型分析年龄、SPI 和检出率之间的关联,分别针对男男性行为者 (MSM)、异性恋男性和女性进行拟合。在 2,876 例艾滋病毒新发病例中,MSM 的检出率最高(1,522/100,000)。13676例梅毒病例中,男女检出比例为1.7:1。在 957 例 猴痘 病例中,80% 发生在 MSM 中 (812/100,000)。HIV 和梅毒集中在 SPI 较低的社区,而 猴痘 集中在 SPI 较高的社区。对于 HIV 而言,MSM 中年龄较小的相关性最强,而女性中 SPI 较低的相关性最强。对于梅毒来说,女性中年龄较小最为重要,两性中 SPI 都有很强的相关性。在 MSM 中,猴痘 集中在 25-39 岁年龄段和 SPI 较高的社区。妇女之间强烈的社会经济梯度反映了性别和社会经济不平等的交叉。在 MSM 中,减弱的社会经济梯度和独特的 猴痘 模式表明,社会和性网络与结构因素一起塑造了 猴痘。预防必须解决社会决定因素和网络结构。

title: Suspected mpox admissions to a dedicated infectious-diseases isolation ward in northeastern Nigeria, 2022–2025: a register-based descriptive study with evidence of a household cluster
abstract: Mpox has re-emerged as a public-health priority across Nigeria, and successive international public-health emergencies were declared in 2022 and 2024. Facility-level descriptions of admitted, clinically suspected cases from northeastern Nigeria remain sparse. We conducted a register-based descriptive study of all admissions to the infectious-diseases isolation ward of Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital, Yola, in which mpox was recorded as the working or a differential diagnosis between February 2022 and January 2025. Age, sex, month of admission, locality, recorded clinical impression, and outcome were abstracted and summarised, with proportions reported using Wilson 95% confidence intervals. Fifteen suspected mpox admissions were identified, representing 4.5% (95% confidence interval 2.8-7.4) of 330 isolation-ward admissions. The median age was 20 years (interquartile range 13-37; range 7-57); six patients (40.0%) were children under 18 years and 12 (80.0%) were male, giving a male-to-female ratio of 4:1. Admissions clustered in 2022 (9 of 15; 60.0%), with six in July 2022, including a probable household cluster of four children and adolescents aged 7-14 years from a single locality who presented within eight days of one another. Three deaths were recorded (case fatality 20.0%, 95% confidence interval 7.0-45.2), including one disseminated case complicated by acute respiratory distress syndrome. The demographic profile closely matches previously reported Adamawa State and national surveillance data, whereas the elevated case fatality reflects referral concentration and diagnostic uncertainty rather than true mpox-attributable mortality. Cases were clinically suspected rather than laboratory-confirmed, which is the principal limitation of this study. We recommend targeted strengthening of laboratory diagnosis at facility and sub-national level, including dual monkeypox-varicella testing algorithms, use of existing molecular platforms rather than new infrastructure, and mandatory recording of laboratory results within ward registers.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes suspected mpox admissions to an infectious-diseases isolation ward in northeastern Nigeria from February 2022 to January 2025. It identifies 15 suspected cases, representing 4.5% of total admissions, with a notable cluster in July 2022 involving four children from the same locality. Three deaths were recorded, with a case fatality rate of 20.0%. The findings suggest that the elevated case fatality rate may be due to diagnostic uncertainty and referral patterns rather than the disease itself. The study highlights the need for improved laboratory diagnosis and reporting. However, the reliance on clinical suspicion rather than laboratory confirmation is a key limitation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘 已重新成为尼日利亚各地的公共卫生优先事项,并于 2022 年和 2024 年连续宣布国际公共卫生紧急情况。来自尼日利亚东北部的收治临床疑似病例的设施级别描述仍然很少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对约拉莫迪博阿达玛大学教学医院传染病隔离病房的所有入院患者进行了一项基于登记的描述性研究,其中 猴痘 被记录为 2022 年 2 月至 2025 年 1 月期间的工作或差异 诊断。
elements_zh.methods: 对年龄、性别、入院月份、地点、记录的临床印象和结果进行了抽象和总结,并使用威尔逊 95% 置信区间报告了比例。
elements_zh.main_results: 确定了 15 例疑似 猴痘 入院病例,占 330 例隔离病房入院病例的 4.5%(95% 置信区间 2.8-7.4)。2022 年入院人数集中(15 人中的 9 人;60.0%),其中 6 人于 2022 年 7 月入院,其中可能包括来自同一地区的 4 名 7-14 岁儿童和青少年,他们彼此在 8 天内就诊。记录了 3 例死亡(病死率 20.0%,95% 置信区间 7.0-45.2),其中包括 1 例并发急性呼吸窘迫综合征的播散性病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 人口统计资料与先前报告的阿达马瓦州和国家 监测 数据非常匹配,而病例死亡率升高反映了转诊集中度和诊断不确定性,而不是真正的 猴痘 归因的 死亡率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们建议有针对性地加强设施和地方层面的实验室 诊断,包括双重猴痘-水痘检测算法、使用现有分子平台而不是新基础设施,以及在病房登记册中强制记录实验室结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 病例是临床怀疑的而非实验室确诊的,这是本研究的主要局限性。

title_zh: 2022-2025 年尼日利亚东北部专门传染病隔离病房疑似 猴痘 入院人数:一项基于登记册的描述性研究,包含家庭聚集的证据
source_body_en: Mpox has re-emerged as a public-health priority across Nigeria, and successive international public-health emergencies were declared in 2022 and 2024. Facility-level descriptions of admitted, clinically suspected cases from northeastern Nigeria remain sparse. We conducted a register-based descriptive study of all admissions to the infectious-diseases isolation ward of Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital, Yola, in which mpox was recorded as the working or a differential diagnosis between February 2022 and January 2025. Age, sex, month of admission, locality, recorded clinical impression, and outcome were abstracted and summarised, with proportions reported using Wilson 95% confidence intervals. Fifteen suspected mpox admissions were identified, representing 4.5% (95% confidence interval 2.8-7.4) of 330 isolation-ward admissions. The median age was 20 years (interquartile range 13-37; range 7-57); six patients (40.0%) were children under 18 years and 12 (80.0%) were male, giving a male-to-female ratio of 4:1. Admissions clustered in 2022 (9 of 15; 60.0%), with six in July 2022, including a probable household cluster of four children and adolescents aged 7-14 years from a single locality who presented within eight days of one another. Three deaths were recorded (case fatality 20.0%, 95% confidence interval 7.0-45.2), including one disseminated case complicated by acute respiratory distress syndrome. The demographic profile closely matches previously reported Adamawa State and national surveillance data, whereas the elevated case fatality reflects referral concentration and diagnostic uncertainty rather than true mpox-attributable mortality. Cases were clinically suspected rather than laboratory-confirmed, which is the principal limitation of this study. We recommend targeted strengthening of laboratory diagnosis at facility and sub-national level, including dual monkeypox-varicella testing algorithms, use of existing molecular platforms rather than new infrastructure, and mandatory recording of laboratory results within ward registers.
abstract_zh: 猴痘 已重新成为尼日利亚各地的公共卫生优先事项,并于 2022 年和 2024 年连续宣布国际公共卫生紧急情况。来自尼日利亚东北部的收治临床疑似病例的设施级别描述仍然很少。我们对约拉莫迪博阿达玛大学教学医院传染病隔离病房的所有入院患者进行了一项基于登记的描述性研究,其中 猴痘 被记录为工作或差异 诊断 2022 年 2 月至 2025 年 1 月。年龄、性别、入院月份、地点、记录的临床印象和结果被提取和总结,并使用 Wilson 95% 置信度报告比例间隔。确定了 15 例疑似 猴痘 入院病例,占 330 例隔离病房入院病例的 4.5%(95% 置信区间 2.8-7.4)。中位年龄为 20 岁(四分位数范围 13-37;范围 7-57);18岁以下儿童6例(40.0%),男性12例(80.0%),男女比例为4:1。2022 年入院人数集中(15 人中的 9 人;60.0%),其中 6 人于 2022 年 7 月入院,其中可能包括来自同一地区的 4 名 7-14 岁儿童和青少年,他们彼此在 8 天内就诊。记录了 3 例死亡(病死率 20.0%,95% 置信区间 7.0-45.2),其中包括 1 例并发急性呼吸窘迫综合征的播散性病例。人口统计资料与先前报告的阿达马瓦州和国家 监测 数据非常匹配,而病例死亡率升高反映了转诊集中度和诊断不确定性,而不是真正的 猴痘 归因的 死亡率。病例是临床怀疑的而非实验室确诊的,这是本研究的主要局限性。我们建议有针对性地加强设施和地方层面的实验室 诊断,包括双重猴痘-水痘检测算法、使用现有分子平台而不是新基础设施,以及在病房登记册中强制记录实验室结果。

title: Prevalence, characteristics, and clinical course of mpox-related ophthalmic disease (MBOTE-EYE): a prospective cohort study in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Systematic longitudinal ophthalmologist-led assessment of mpox-related ophthalmic disease (MPOXROD) is rarely reported. We aimed to characterise the prevalence and clinical course of MPOXROD under supportive management during a clade Ib outbreak. METHODS: MBOTE-EYE was a substudy nested within a prospective cohort in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. All hospitalised patients with PCR-confirmed mpox (within the last 48 h) were eligible. Participants underwent ophthalmological examination at enrolment, discharge, and days 29 and 59. Conjunctival swabs were collected for monkeypox virus PCR. Risk factors for MPOXROD were assessed using mixed-effects Poisson regression. FINDINGS: Between Oct 28, 2024, and June 30, 2025, 310 participants were enrolled (median age 14·0 years [IQR 2·5-25·0]; 166 [54%] female). At enrolment, conjunctival disease was present in 112 (36% [95% CI 31-42]) participants, corneal disease in 24 (8% [5-11]), and anterior uveitis in two (1% [0-2]). Overall, 134 (43% [38-49]) participants developed MPOXROD during follow-up, most often bilaterally. Blindness following ulcerative keratitis occurred in two (1% [0-3]) of 224 participants. Periorbital lesions (adjusted risk ratio [aRR] 3·65 [95% CI 2·42-5·49]) and severe acute malnutrition (aRR 3·16 [1·22-8·22]) were associated with MPOXROD. PCR was done among 89 patients and cycle threshold values below 25 occurred exclusively during active MPOXROD. INTERPRETATION: Ophthalmic involvement in clade Ib mpox is common and frequently bilateral, with a substantial burden of keratitis and risk of vision loss. Systematic eye examinations should be integrated into mpox care, and targeted ophthalmic therapies should be developed. FUNDING: Canadian Institutes of Health Research and the International Development Research Centre, the European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership, and the Belgian Directorate-General for Development Cooperation and Humanitarian Aid.

Ophthalmological examinations were performed at multiple time points, and conjunctival swabs were collected for PCR testing. The results showed that 36% of participants had conjunctival disease at enrolment, 8% had corneal disease, and 1% had anterior uveitis. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 关于猴痘病毒相关眼部疾病(MPOXROD)的系统性纵向眼科医师主导评估鲜有报道。本研究旨在在Ib分支猴痘病毒流行期间,在支持性治疗下,对MPOXROD的患病率及临床进程进行特征描述。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: MBOTE-EYE是一项嵌套于刚果民主共和国南基伍省前瞻性队列研究中的子研究。所有在过去48小时内经PCR确诊为猴痘病毒感染的住院患者均符合入组条件。参与者在入组、出院及第29天和第59天接受眼科检查。
elements_zh.methods: 收集结膜拭子用于猴痘病毒 PCR。对 89 名患者进行了 PCR,低于 25 的循环阈值仅发生在活动性 MPOXROD 期间。使用混合效应泊松回归评估 MPOXROD 的危险因素。
elements_zh.main_results: Between Oct 28, 2024, and June 30, 2025, 310 participants were enrolled (median age 14·0 years [IQR 2·5-25·0]; 166 [54%] female). elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Ib 猴痘 分支的眼部受累很常见,且常常是双侧的,具有严重的角膜炎负担和视力丧失的风险。系统的眼科检查应纳入 猴痘 护理中,并应开发有针对性的眼科治疗。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了将眼科评估纳入 猴痘 监测 和管理的重要性。他们还强调需要有针对性的眼科治疗,以解决与 Ib 猴痘 分支相关的眼部并发症的重大负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究,嵌套在一项更大的研究中,这可能会限制普遍性。证据充分,基于详细的方法和清晰的结果报告进行了高置信度评估。

title: Machine learning-assisted design of a dendritic cell nanovaccine inducing twin immunity against monkeypox.
abstract: The global emergence of monkeypox virus (MPXV) has created an urgent need for effective vaccines that induce robust immune responses. Here, we report a biomimetic nano-vaccine platform based on engineered dendritic cell membrane vesicles displaying M1R (M1R-CMVs), designed via genetic engineering with machine learning-assisted preliminary screening of physicochemical parameters including particle size (~190 nm) and zeta potential (-18 mV). Subcutaneous delivery of M1R-CMVs with CpG adjuvant induced high titers of M1R-specific IgG and potent neutralizing antibodies. The vaccine promoted broad T cell activation, characterized by enhanced CD4 + and CD8 + T cell responses in spleen and lymph nodes, and established durable T cell memory. In vitro studies demonstrated that M1R-CMVs enhance dendritic cell maturation and T cell proliferation. Prime-boost immunization further amplified both humoral and cellular immunity, with significant increases in neutralizing antibody titers and effector T cell populations. Furthermore, the vaccine exhibited a favorable safety profile in vivo with no significant toxicity observed. Our findings demonstrate a biomimetic vaccine design strategy integrating engineered vesicles with machine learning-assisted physicochemical analysis, providing a promising approach to combat monkeypox.

title: SYSTEMATIC REVIEW OF MPOX SEROPREVALENCE IN NIGERIA: EPIDEMIOLOGY, DEMOGRAPHICS, RISK FACTORS, AND CONTROL
abstract: Mpox is a re-emerging zoonotic disease caused by a double-stranded DNA virus of the genus Orthopoxvirus. Since 2017, Nigeria has witnessed a resurgence of Mpox, with outbreaks of increasing magnitude. This study analyzed surveillance data from the Surveillance Outbreak Response and Management System (SORMAS) spanning September 2017 to February 2025, to describe the epidemiology of Mpox and assess implications for surveillance and response. A total of 5,979 suspected cases were reported, of which 1,303 (21.8%) were laboratory-confirmed. Males accounted for 63% of suspected and 65.9% of confirmed cases, while females comprised 37% and 34.1% respectively. The largely affected age group was 20–29 years (47.7% of confirmed cases), reflecting vulnerability among post-smallpox vaccination cohorts. Children under 15 years represented 16% of confirmed cases. Temporal trends revealed outbreak peaks in 2017, 2022, and 2024, suggesting repeated waves and ongoing endemic transmission. Five states (Sokoto, Akwa Ibom, Lagos, Ogun, and Ondo) contributed ~60% of cases, indicating geographic clustering. The overall case fatality rate (CFR) was 7.8%, with slightly higher mortality among females (8.1%) and children (8.2%). Risk factor analysis highlighted both occupational exposure (business/traders, students, farmers) and household clustering (housewives, infants). However, only 9.6% of suspected and 5% of confirmed cases reported contact with an infectious source, underscoring weak case investigation. Surveillance through SORMAS improved data capture and timeliness but was limited by underreporting, incomplete exposure data, and diagnostic bottlenecks. Findings emphasize the need for enhanced One Health surveillance, decentralized diagnostics, community-driven reporting, and targeted risk communication. This study concludes that Mpox in Nigeria has transitioned from sporadic spillover to sustained endemic transmission. Strengthening surveillance and response systems is critical to reducing morbidity, mortality, and the risk of further international spread.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 猴痘 是一种重新出现的人畜共患疾病,由 正痘病毒 属的双链 DNA 病毒引起。自2017年以来,尼日利亚出现了“猴痘”的死灰复燃,且“暴发”的规模不断加大。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本研究分析了 监测 暴发 响应和管理系统 (SORMAS) 2017 年 9 月至 2025 年 2 月的 监测 数据,以描述 猴痘 的 流行病学 并评估对 监测 和响应的影响。监测 通过 SORMAS 改进了数据捕获和及时性,但受到报告不足、暴露数据不完整和诊断瓶颈的限制。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 共报告疑似病例5,979例,其中实验室确诊病例1,303例(21.8%)。受影响最大的年龄组是 20-29 岁(确诊病例的 47.7%),反映了天花后 疫苗接种 队列研究 的脆弱性。总体病死率 (CFR) 为 7.8%,其中女性 (8.1%) 和儿童 (8.2%) 的 死亡率 略高。调查结果强调需要增强 One Health 监测、分散诊断、社区驱动的报告和有针对性的风险沟通。

title: Rethinking mpox: epidemiology, clinical variants, diagnosis, and response
abstract: Monkeypox disease, now commonly referred to as mpox, was once considered a geographically restricted zoonotic disease but has emerged as a global public health concern. The 2022 multinational outbreak marked a turning point, with notable shifts in transmission dynamics, affected populations, and clinical manifestations. Classical cases typically involve fever, lymphadenopathy, and a centrifugal vesiculopustular rash; however, recent outbreaks have revealed atypical presentations, including genital and perianal lesions, minimal or absent prodromal symptoms, and asynchronous rash evolution. These variations have complicated early clinical recognition and may contribute to delayed diagnosis and onward transmission. This review synthesizes current evidence on the evolving epidemiology of mpox, highlights differences between endemic and non-endemic outbreaks, and describes the full spectrum of typical and atypical clinical features. It also assesses diagnostic approaches, including molecular and point-of-care techniques, and evaluates the efficacy and limitations of current and emerging vaccines, such as JYNNEOS and ACAM2000. Future priorities include improving global surveillance, refining case definitions, expanding diagnostic access, and ensuring equitable vaccine distribution. Understanding the expanding clinical and epidemiological profile of mpox is essential for timely diagnosis, containment, and preparedness against future outbreaks.

title: Examining knowledge of Mpox among primary care physicians in North-Western Nigeria: an online cross-sectional study
abstract: Abstract Background Mpox is a rare but re-emerging zoonotic disease that causes significant morbidity and mortality. As primary care physicians serve as gatekeepers in the healthcare system, it is essential that they be proficient at identifying and coordinating care for suspected Mpox patients. However, there is a scarcity of studies on the knowledge of Mpox among primary care doctors in the northwestern geopolitical zone of Nigeria. Objectives This study assessed the knowledge of Mpox and its associated sociodemographic factors among primary care physicians in northwestern Nigeria. Methods This cross-sectional online study employed a multi-stage sampling technique to survey primary care physicians working in Family Medicine/General Outpatient and Pediatric Outpatient Clinics across hospitals in the seven states of North-Western Nigeria. The minimum sample size of 153 was calculated using an assumed 50% prevalence of good Mpox knowledge, a 5% margin of error, and a 95% confidence level; this was increased to 170 after adding a 10% non-response buffer. A total of 155 physicians completed the survey, giving a completion rate of 91.2%. Data were collected using a pretested, online questionnaire, and descriptive and inferential statistical analyses were done using Epi Info (version 7). Results The mean age of participants was 38.8 ± 7.4 years, with male preponderance (60.7%). Most were general outpatient clinic doctors (77.4%), with ≥ 10 years of practice experience (63.2%), and senior registrars (36.1%). Only 18.9% had prior experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox. Nine (5.8%) had good knowledge of Mpox, with a mean overall knowledge score of 61.7 ± 12.5%. Participants with ≥ 10 years of practice experience ( p = 0.049), senior professional cadres ( p = 0.031), and involvement in diagnosing or managing Mpox ( p = 0.021) were associated with higher mean knowledge scores. Conclusions The overall good knowledge rate was notably low, indicating a significant gap in participants’ knowledge of the various aspects of the disease. Senior professional cadres, long years of practice, and experience in the diagnosis and management of Mpox were associated with higher yet suboptimal knowledge scores. Hence, targeted educational interventions are needed to enhance their preparedness to identify and coordinate Mpox cases in primary care settings.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Mpox is a re-emerging zoonotic disease with significant morbidity and mortality, and primary care physicians are critical gatekeepers for identifying and managing suspected cases. There was a scarcity of studies assessing Mpox knowledge among primary care doctors in North-Western Nigeria, creating a knowledge gap that this study aimed to address.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a cross-sectional online study conducted among primary care physicians working in Family Medicine/General Outpatient and Pediatric Outpatient Clinics across hospitals in the seven states of North-Western Nigeria. A total of 155 physicians completed the survey, representing a 91.2% completion rate.
analysis.methods: Data were collected using a pretested, online questionnaire, and descriptive and inferential statistical analyses were performed using Epi Info (version 7). A multi-stage sampling technique was employed, and the minimum sample size of 153 was calculated using an assumed 50% prevalence of good Mpox knowledge, a 5% margin of error, and a 95% confidence level, increased to 170 after adding a 10% non-response buffer.
analysis.main_results: The mean age of participants was 38.8 ± 7.4 years, with a male preponderance (60.7%). Only 18.9% had prior experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox, and 5.8% had good knowledge of Mpox, with a mean overall knowledge score of 61.7 ± 12.5%. Participants with ≥10 years of practice experience (p=0.049), senior professional cadres (p=0.031), and experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox (p=0.021) were associated with higher mean knowledge scores.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the notably low overall good knowledge rate as indicating a significant gap in participants' knowledge of Mpox. They highlighted that senior professional cadres, long years of practice, and experience in diagnosis and management were associated with higher yet suboptimal knowledge scores, underscoring the need for targeted educational interventions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeted educational interventions are needed to enhance primary care physicians' preparedness to identify and coordinate Mpox cases in primary care settings, which could improve surveillance, diagnosis, and patient management in North-Western Nigeria.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported knowledge scores limit causal inference and may introduce response bias. The evidence strength is moderate due to the small sample size and the use of a convenience sampling method, which may affect generalisability to other regions or healthcare settings.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional online study assessed Mpox knowledge among 155 primary care physicians in North-Western Nigeria, revealing a notably low overall good knowledge rate of 5.8% and a mean knowledge score of 61.7%. Only 18.9% had prior experience managing Mpox, and higher knowledge scores were associated with senior professional cadres, longer practice experience, and prior Mpox management experience. title_zh: 西北尼日利亚初级保健医师对猴痘知识水平的调查:一项在线横断面研究
source_body_en: Abstract Background Mpox is a rare but re-emerging zoonotic disease that causes significant morbidity and mortality. As primary care physicians serve as gatekeepers in the healthcare system, it is essential that they be proficient at identifying and coordinating care for suspected Mpox patients. However, there is a scarcity of studies on the knowledge of Mpox among primary care doctors in the northwestern geopolitical zone of Nigeria. Objectives This study assessed the knowledge of Mpox and its associated sociodemographic factors among primary care physicians in northwestern Nigeria. Methods This cross-sectional online study employed a multi-stage sampling technique to survey primary care physicians working in Family Medicine/General Outpatient and Pediatric Outpatient Clinics across hospitals in the seven states of North-Western Nigeria. The minimum sample size of 153 was calculated using an assumed 50% prevalence of good Mpox knowledge, a 5% margin of error, and a 95% confidence level; this was increased to 170 after adding a 10% non-response buffer. A total of 155 physicians completed the survey, giving a completion rate of 91.2%. Data were collected using a pretested, online questionnaire, and descriptive and inferential statistical analyses were done using Epi Info (version 7). Results The mean age of participants was 38.8 ± 7.4 years, with male preponderance (60.7%). Most were general outpatient clinic doctors (77.4%), with ≥ 10 years of practice experience (63.2%), and senior registrars (36.1%). Only 18.9% had prior experience in diagnosing or managing Mpox. Nine (5.8%) had good knowledge of Mpox, with a mean overall knowledge score of 61.7 ± 12.5%. Participants with ≥ 10 years of practice experience ( p = 0.049), senior professional cadres ( p = 0.031), and involvement in diagnosing or managing Mpox ( p = 0.021) were associated with higher mean knowledge scores. Conclusions The overall good knowledge rate was notably low, indicating a significant gap in participants’ knowledge of the various aspects of the disease. Senior professional cadres, long years of practice, and experience in the diagnosis and management of Mpox were associated with higher yet suboptimal knowledge scores. Hence, targeted educational interventions are needed to enhance their preparedness to identify and coordinate Mpox cases in primary care settings.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 猴痘 是一种罕见但重新出现的人畜共患疾病,可导致显着的发病率和 死亡率。由于初级保健医生充当医疗保健系统的看门人,因此他们必须精通识别和协调疑似 猴痘 患者的护理。然而,关于尼日利亚西北地缘政治区初级保健医生猴痘知识的研究却很少。目的 本研究评估了尼日利亚西北部初级保健医生对 猴痘 的了解及其相关的社会人口统计学因素。方法 这项横断面在线研究采用多阶段抽样技术对尼日利亚西北部七个州各医院的家庭医学/普通门诊和儿科门诊诊所工作的初级保健医生进行调查。最小样本量 153 是使用假设 50% 患病率 良好的 猴痘 知识、5% 的误差幅度和 95% 的置信水平计算得出的;添加 10% 无响应缓冲液后,该值增加至 170。共有 155 名医生完成了调查,完成率为 91.2%。使用预先测试的在线调查问卷收集数据,并使用 Epi Info(第 7 版)进行描述性和推论性统计分析。结果 参与者的平均年龄为 38.8 ± 7.4 岁,其中男性占多数(60.7%)。大部分为普通门诊医生(77.4%)、执业经验10年以上(63.2%)、高级挂号师(36.1%)。只有 18.9% 的人有诊断或治疗 猴痘 的经验。九人 (5.8%) 对 猴痘 有良好的了解,平均总体知识得分为 61.7 ± 12.5%。具有≥ 10年实践经验(p = 0.049)、高级专业干部(p = 0.031)以及参与诊断或处理猴痘(p = 0.021)的参与者与较高的平均知识得分相关。结论 总体良好知识率明显较低,表明参与者对该疾病各个方面的知识存在显着差距。高级专业干部、多年的实践经验以及诊断和猴痘管理经验与较高但次优的知识得分相关。因此,需要有针对性的教育干预措施,以增强他们在初级保健机构中识别和协调 猴痘 病例的准备。

title: Evaluating search-enabled large language model interfaces for mpox public health consultation: a guideline-based comparative study
abstract: Background Search-enabled large language model interfaces are increasingly used by the public for health information, but their performance in mpox-related public health consultation remains unclear. This study evaluated their safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability. Methods We conducted a single-query comparative cross-sectional evaluation using 52 predefined mpox-related public consultation questions. Each question was submitted once to each of six search-enabled LLM interfaces, yielding 312 first responses. Responses were assessed against a guideline-based reference framework. Safety was coded as a binary outcome, while accuracy and empathy were rated on 5-point scales. Reliability/information quality was evaluated using DISCERN, EQIP, JAMA benchmark criteria, and GQS. Readability was assessed using six established readability indices. Five trained raters independently evaluated the human-scored outcomes. Results Unsafe responses were relatively infrequent but occurred in all six interfaces, with safe-response rates ranging from 86.5 to 92.3%. No pairwise difference in Safety remained statistically significant after Benjamini–Hochberg correction. Overall differences across interfaces were statistically significant for Accuracy, Empathy, all four reliability/information quality measures, and all six readability indices. Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted post hoc analyses identified outcome-specific pairwise differences, although the pairwise patterns varied across measures. Conclusion The evaluated search-enabled LLM interfaces showed heterogeneous performance across safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability. Although unsafe responses were relatively uncommon, potentially harmful outputs occurred in every interface. These findings support the need for guideline-based evaluation, source transparency, readability optimization, and robust safety safeguards when such interfaces are evaluated or considered for mpox-related public health consultation. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the performance of six search-enabled large language model (LLM) interfaces in mpox-related public health consultation. The research aimed to assess safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability of responses to 52 predefined mpox-related questions. Each question was submitted to all six interfaces, resulting in 312 responses. The responses were evaluated using a guideline-based reference framework, with safety as a binary outcome, accuracy and empathy on 5-point scales, reliability/information quality using DISCERN, EQIP, JAMA benchmark criteria, and GQS, and readability using six established indices. The results showed that unsafe responses were relatively infrequent but occurred in all interfaces, with safe-response rates ranging from 86.5 to 92.3%. No pairwise difference in safety remained statistically significant after Benjamini–Hochberg correction. However, overall differences across interfaces were statistically significant for accuracy, empathy, reliability/information quality, and readability. The study highlights the need for guideline-based evaluation, source transparency, readability optimization, and safety safeguards for LLM interfaces used in mpox-related public health consultation. The findings are limited to a specific time and configuration snapshot and should not be generalized to base models or interpreted as establishing reproducible performance or a stable hierarchy across different settings.

title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

abstract_zh: 简介:全球 暴发 猴痘风险需要高效的诊断工具。目前的方法速度缓慢,并且难以区分相似的皮肤病变,而深度学习模型缺乏多类分类的准确性和可解释性。本研究旨在开发一种高性能、实时筛查工具,用于早期检测猴痘和类似病症。方法:本研究提出了一种增强的架构,将高效通道注意力(HECA)机制纳入 YOLOv11 中,以改进特征选择。HECA 对输入特征图执行全局平均池化 (GAP) 和最大平均池化 (MAP)。该研究利用空间变换和像素域增强,建立并增强了包含猴痘、麻疹、水痘和正常皮肤图像的四类数据集。梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 生成用于病变定位可视化的热图,而基于 PyQt5 的交互式诊断界面则简化了临床工作流程。结果:实验结果表明,与测试集上的现有方法(EfficientNet-v2-l、GoogLeNet、ResNet50、VGG19、MobileNetv2、DenseNet201 和 YOLOv11s)相比,所提出的模型具有优越的性能,具有增强的检测速度、准确度(98.9%)、精确度(99%)、召回率(99.3%)和 F1 分数(99.1%)。在所有评估指标中,HECA-YOLOv11 的性能均优于 SE-YOLOv11 和 ECA-YOLOv11 超过 5.1%。热图分析证实了该模型对病变区域的关注,与医学推理相一致。讨论:集成的注意力机制和可解释性技术有效地解决了自动皮肤病变检测的关键限制。高性能和低延迟标志着可靠临床决策支持的重大进步,对早期 暴发 遏制具有重要意义。结论:HECA-YOLOv11框架为早期猴痘筛查提供了高度准确和高效的工具。其标准化界面在加速公共卫生应对和改善新发传染病的全球控制方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Drivers of Viral Spillover: An Examination of How Pathogens Spread
abstract: The occurrence of viral zoonotic spillover (the transmission of viruses from animals to humans) has attracted worldwide attention due to mounting concerns regarding viral threats such as avian influenza, Hendra, monkeypox, Nipah and bat coronaviruses. It is evident that these events deviate significantly from natural occurrences, being the conflation of ecological, environmental and social factors that are profoundly altering the boundaries between the animal and human domains. Consequently, in order to comprehend both the contemporary and prospective drivers of zoonotic viral spillover, a coordinated, comprehensive global One Health response is essential. The purpose of the present review is to analyze prevailing pathways of transmission between animal reservoirs and human populations. This examination involves the analysis of historical cases, including those of SARS and Ebola, as well as recent occurrences, such as the global pandemic of SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). A secondary objective of this review is to comprehend the fundamental mechanisms of cross-species transmission. The development of effective strategies to mitigate the emergence of zoonotic viruses and prevent future pandemics is contingent on a robust understanding of these mechanisms. This analysis is key to identifying pandemic pathogens and preventing the spread of zoonotic viruses. In conclusion, the review provides a thorough evaluation of current global strategies to prevent the spread of zoonotic viruses, highlighting gaps in our understanding and areas for further research.

title: Infections and sepsis
abstract: Abstract This chapter provides an up-to-date overview of infection screening, management, and prevention in pregnancy, with a particular focus on sepsis. It covers national guidance on antenatal screening for syphilis, HIV, hepatitis B, and rubella, emphasising the importance of early detection and multidisciplinary care to reduce vertical transmission and improve outcomes. The chapter details the significance of group B haemolytic Streptococcus, outlining risk factors, screening protocols, and recommendations for intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis. Common infections such as influenza, urinary tract infections, chickenpox, toxoplasmosis, Mpox, and COVID-19 are discussed, with practical midwifery advice for diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention. The chapter highlights the increased risk of sepsis in pregnancy due to immunological changes and obstetric interventions, stressing the need for prompt recognition, rapid intervention, and multidisciplinary collaboration. Key clinical signs, assessment tools, and the Sepsis Six protocol are presented to support early identification and management. Throughout, the chapter integrates current research, national standards, and real-world practice, equipping midwives to deliver safe, effective care and reduce maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality associated with infections and sepsis.

title_zh: 感染和败血症
source_body_en: Abstract This chapter provides an up-to-date overview of infection screening, management, and prevention in pregnancy, with a particular focus on sepsis. It covers national guidance on antenatal screening for syphilis, HIV, hepatitis B, and rubella, emphasising the importance of early detection and multidisciplinary care to reduce vertical transmission and improve outcomes. The chapter details the significance of group B haemolytic Streptococcus, outlining risk factors, screening protocols, and recommendations for intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis. Common infections such as influenza, urinary tract infections, chickenpox, toxoplasmosis, Mpox, and COVID-19 are discussed, with practical midwifery advice for diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention. The chapter highlights the increased risk of sepsis in pregnancy due to immunological changes and obstetric interventions, stressing the need for prompt recognition, rapid intervention, and multidisciplinary collaboration. Key clinical signs, assessment tools, and the Sepsis Six protocol are presented to support early identification and management. Throughout, the chapter integrates current research, national standards, and real-world practice, equipping midwives to deliver safe, effective care and reduce maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality associated with infections and sepsis.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本章提供了妊娠期感染筛查、管理和预防的最新概述,特别关注败血症。它涵盖了梅毒、艾滋病毒、乙型肝炎和风疹产前筛查的国家指南,强调早期检测和多学科护理对于减少垂直 传播 和改善结果的重要性。本章详细介绍了 B 族溶血性链球菌的重要性,概述了危险因素、筛查方案以及产时抗生素预防的建议。讨论了流感、尿路感染、水痘、弓形体病、猴痘 和 COVID-19 等常见感染,并提供了有关 诊断、治疗 选项和预防的实用助产建议。本章强调了由于免疫变化和产科干预导致妊娠期脓毒症风险增加,强调需要及时识别、快速干预和多学科合作。提出了关键的临床症状、评估工具和脓毒症六号方案以支持早期识别和管理。本章自始至终整合了当前的研究、国家标准和现实世界的实践,使助产士能够提供安全、有效的护理,并降低孕产妇和新生儿的发病率以及与感染和败血症相关的 死亡率。

Ampofi Department of Mathematical Sciences, University of Mines and Technology, Tarkwa, Ghana Corresponding Author: [email protected] Article Information: Journal: International Journal of Advances in Applied Mathematics and Mechanics (IJAAMM) Volume: 14, Issue: 1, Pages: 108-121 Issue Date: September 2026 License: CC BY 4.0 DOI: https://doi.org/10.26541/ijaamm.2026.140110 Article History: Received 2026-06-22 00:00:00, Revised 2026-08-14 00:00:00, Accepted 2026-08-25 00:00:00, Published online 27 August 2026 Cite: D.A. Arhinful, A.Y. Anafo, I. Ampofi , Stability and sensitivity analysis of transmission dynamics of Mpox virus, Int. J. Adv. Appl. Math. and Mech. 14(1) (2026) 108-121. https://doi.org/10.26541/ijaamm.2026.140110 Abstract A deterministic compartmental model is formulated for Mpox transmission dynamics in interacting human and rodent populations. The human population is divided into susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered classes; the rodent population into susceptible, exposed, and infectious classes. A quarantined-to-susceptible pathway is incorporated to capture undetected cases re-entering the at-risk population. The basic reproduction number $R_{0}$ is derived using the next-generation matrix method. Local asymptotic stability of the disease-free equilibrium is established whenever $R_{0}<1$, and global asymptotic stability is proved using the Castillo-Chavez and Song approach. Routh-Hurwitz conditions are also derived for the endemic equilibrium. Normalised forward sensitivity analysis identifies the human-to-human rate and proportion of exposed humans to infected class as the dominant drivers of transmission; increasing recovery and treatment rates reduces $R_0$. Numerical simulations confirm that all infectious compartments decline asymptotically to zero when $R_{0}<1$, consistent with disease elimination. These results offer a quantitative basis for designing targeted Mpox control interventions, particularly through contact reduction and improved treatment coverage. Keywords Mpox; Deterministic model; Basic reproduction number; Disease-free equilibrium; Stability analysis; Sensitivity analysis; Next-generation matrix; Routh-Hurwitz criterion MSC (2020) 92D30; 34D20

title_original: Stability and sensitivity analysis of transmission dynamics of Mpox virus

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to analyze the transmission dynamics of Mpox virus through stability and sensitivity analysis to understand the factors influencing its spread and inform control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A deterministic compartmental model was formulated to study Mpox transmission dynamics in interacting human and rodent populations, with the human population divided into susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered classes, and the rodent population into susceptible, exposed, and infectious classes.
analysis.methods: The study used a deterministic compartmental model, incorporating a quarantined-to-susceptible pathway to account for undetected cases. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was calculated using the next-generation matrix method, and stability of equilibria was analyzed using Routh-Hurwitz conditions and Castillo-Chavez and Song approaches.
analysis.main_results: The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was derived, and it was found that the human-to-human transmission rate and the proportion of exposed humans entering the infectious class are the dominant drivers of transmission. Increasing recovery and treatment rates was shown to reduce $R_0$.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide a quantitative understanding of the key factors driving Mpox transmission and highlight the importance of contact reduction and improved treatment coverage in controlling the disease.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer a foundation for designing targeted interventions to reduce Mpox transmission, particularly by focusing on contact tracing and enhancing treatment protocols.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a deterministic model, which may not fully capture real-world complexities such as stochasticity or variability in transmission rates. The evidence is strong for the model's stability analysis but limited in its applicability to real-world scenarios without further empirical validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a deterministic compartmental model to analyze the transmission dynamics of Mpox virus in human and rodent populations. The model incorporates a quarantined-to-susceptible pathway to account for undetected cases. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was derived using the next-generation matrix method, and stability of equilibria was assessed. The results indicate that human-to-human transmission rate and proportion of exposed humans entering the infectious class are the main drivers of Mpox spread. Increasing recovery and treatment rates was found to reduce $R_0$. The findings suggest that targeted interventions, such as contact reduction and improved treatment coverage, could be effective in controlling the disease. However, the study's deterministic nature may limit its real-world applicability, and further empirical validation is needed to strengthen the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过稳定性和敏感性分析来分析 传播 的动态,以了解影响其传播的因素并为控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 制定了确定性区室模型来研究人类和啮齿动物群体相互作用中的 猴痘 传播 动态,其中人类群体分为易感、暴露、传染、隔离和康复类别,啮齿动物群体分为易感、暴露和传染类别。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用了确定性区室模型,结合了从隔离到易感的途径来解释未发现的病例。使用下一代矩阵方法计算基本再生数$R_0$,并使用Routh-Hurwitz条件和Castillo-Chavez和Song方法分析平衡稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 推导了基本传染数$R_0$,发现人传人传播率和暴露人群进入传染类别的比例是传播的主导驱动因素。提高回收率和 治疗 率可减少 $R_0$。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to analyze the transmission dynamics of Mpox virus through stability and sensitivity analysis to understand the factors influencing its spread and inform control strategies.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A deterministic compartmental model was formulated to study Mpox transmission dynamics in interacting human and rodent populations, with the human population divided into susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered classes, and the rodent population into susceptible, exposed, and infectious classes.
analysis_en.methods: The study used a deterministic compartmental model, incorporating a quarantined-to-susceptible pathway to account for undetected cases. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was calculated using the next-generation matrix method, and stability of equilibria was analyzed using Routh-Hurwitz conditions and Castillo-Chavez and Song approaches.
analysis_en.main_results: The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was derived, and it was found that the human-to-human transmission rate and the proportion of exposed humans entering the infectious class are the dominant drivers of transmission. Increasing recovery and treatment rates was shown to reduce $R_0$.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide a quantitative understanding of the key factors driving Mpox transmission and highlight the importance of contact reduction and improved treatment coverage in controlling the disease.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer a foundation for designing targeted interventions to reduce Mpox transmission, particularly by focusing on contact tracing and enhancing treatment protocols.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a deterministic model, which may not fully capture real-world complexities such as stochasticity or variability in transmission rates. The evidence is strong for the model's stability analysis but limited in its applicability to real-world scenarios without further empirical validation.

Volume 32, Supplement –Summer 2026 SUPPLEMENT ISSUE Other Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025 Cite This Article Citation for Media Abstract In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response. Since the first case was identified in a nonendemic region, mpox has emerged as an increasing public health concern in the United States. The global outbreak in 2022 affected 75 countries and territories; >2,300 cases had been confirmed in the United States by July 2022 (1). Because of evolving transmission dynamics, severity, and uncertainty surrounding social and economic impacts, the World Health Organization declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern on July 23, 2022 (2–3). Mpox is an infectious disease endemic to regions of Central and West Africa. It is caused by the enveloped DNA virus monkeypox virus (MPXV) and is characterized by fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and a vesiculopustular rash that can involve the face, extremities, and genital region (3). Mpox is primarily transmitted through direct contact with active lesions, contaminated materials, bodily fluids, or respiratory transmission at close range (4,5). Mpox infections are categorized into 2 genetically distinct clades, clade I and clade II. Clade II infections, which were responsible for the global outbreak that began in 2022, are generally associated with less severe disease and reduced transmissibility (5). Historically, clade I mpox infections have demonstrated greater virulence, mortality, and transmission (6). The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Wastewater Surveillance System initiated wastewater testing for MPXV in October 2022, five months after the mpox outbreak began in the United States. For underreported and stigmatized infections such as mpox, traditional case-based surveillance can present challenges, including incomplete capture of subclinical or unreported cases, making wastewater surveillance a valuable complementary approach to clinical mpox surveillance (5,6). Early work demonstrated that viral shedding through urine, feces, respiratory secretions, and skin lesions can result in detectable MPXV in wastewater, supporting wastewater-based epidemiology as a viable approach for monitoring and quantifying community transmission (2,7,8). In 1 study, MPXV detections in wastewater were shown to precede the identification of the clinical cases, highlighting its potential for early outbreak detection (9). Another study reported increases in wastewater viral concentrations ahead of reported clinical cases (5). Studies have also documented correlations between wastewater MPXV concentrations and incident mpox cases within corresponding sewersheds, supporting the utility of wastewater surveillance as a proxy for community-level transmission (10). Finally, wastewater detections in areas without corresponding clinical reports may help identify communities where mpox transmission might otherwise remain undetected because of social stigma, limited clinical recognition, or constrained diagnostic capacity (5,9). Recognizing wastewater surveillance as a valuable strategy for early identification of infectious disease activity, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS) integrated mpox monitoring into its statewide wastewater surveillance program. In September 2023, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at selected wastewater surveillance sites across the state. That assay detects orthopoxviruses including vaccinia, cowpox, and all clades of MPXV. Primary sites were facilities in Asheville, Charlotte, Greensboro, Greenville, and Raleigh; additional periodic testing was conducted at selected sites in Cary, Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham. To evaluate mpox wastewater surveillance program in North Carolina, we conducted this study to estimate sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) relative to confirmed clinical cases. Study Area and Surveillance Period We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance analysis to evaluate wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV circulation in North Carolina. For the period October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, we compared wastewater detections from the North Carolina Wastewater Monitoring Network, operated by the NCDHHS, with confirmed clinical mpox cases using a +17-day temporal window. We assumed clinical case reporting to be complete for the purposes of this analysis. The study included data from 16 publicly owned wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) with defined catchment areas serving a combined population of 2,002,864 persons (Table 1). Facilities were in urban and semiurban regions and consisted of 4 plants in Charlotte, 3 plants each in Cary and Raleigh, and 1 plant each in Asheville, Chapel Hill, Greensboro, Greenville, North Durham, and South Durham. During the study period, 45 confirmed mpox cases occurred within the included sewersheds. We excluded sites sampled through CDC-contracted programs (Verily, https://verily.com) and WastewaterSCAN (https://www.wastewaterscan.org) because of differences in laboratory methods, assays, reporting structures, and sampling frequency. Clinical Case Data We also obtained clinical case data from NCDHHS. A confirmed mpox case was defined according to the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists case definition from 2022 (22-ID-10) as detection of nonvariola orthopoxvirus or MPXV DNA in a clinical specimen by PCR in a patient with compatible symptoms (11). We defined case date as date of symptom onset. We geocoded cases using residential address and spatially assigned them to sewersheds by using ArcGIS Pro (Esri, https://www.esri.com). Wastewater Sample Collection and Laboratory Testing. Influent wastewater was collected as 24-hour composite samples approximately 1 time/week at each WWTP except for the 3 plants in Cary and those in Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham, which were only sampled selectively over the study period, generally in response to concerns about a confirmed or suspected mpox case in the general area. Samples were transported on ice and processed within 24 hours at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. We quantified MPXV DNA using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test (12). We originally optimized the assay in a wastewater matrix by conducting a thermal gradient from 62°C–52°C to see which annealing temperature resulted in the greatest separation from positive and negative droplet clusters (Appendix Figure). We reported results as viral gene copies normalized to flow rate and population within the sewershed. We classified samples with concentrations above the assay limit of detection (LOD) as positive (n = 17). We experimentally determined the assay limit of blank (LOB) to be 0 copies/L by using methods adapted from Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute document EP17 (13). Because the LOB was 0, we theoretically estimated the assay LOD to be 500 copies/L, because Poisson distribution requires roughly 3 copies per sample to detect >1 copies with 95% probability (14,15). Using this strategy, we classified samples with concentrations from one half the LOD to the LOD as trace detections (n = 30). Overall Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, and NPV We classified wastewater observations as positive or negative on the basis of laboratory results, as described previously. For each wastewater sample, the presence of >1 confirmed clinical case within +17 days in the same sewershed was assessed. We selected a +17-day alignment window to approximate the biologically plausible period during which MPXV might be detectable in wastewater relative to a reported clinical case. Available data suggest that viral shedding is most likely to occur at 4 to 25 days (16,17) and might begin before diagnosis. Additional delays related to seeking care, laboratory confirmation, case reporting, and wastewater sampling can create temporal offsets between infection and detection. We selected the +17-day window to balance those biological and operational considerations while minimizing misclassification. We defined diagnostic categories as follows: true positive (TP), wastewater-positive and >1 clinical case within +17 days; false positive (FP), wastewater-positive and no clinical case within +17 days; true negative (TN), wastewater-negative and no clinical case within +17 days; and false negative (FN), wastewater-negative and >1 clinical case within +17 days. We calculated sensitivity (TP/[TP + FN]), specificity (TN/[TN + FP]), PPV (TP/[TP + FP]), and NPV (TN/[TN + FN]) overall and stratified results by WWTP/sewershed catchment. We calculated 95% CIs using Wilson score intervals because several sites had small denominators and proportions near 0 or 1. The primary analysis classified both positive and trace detections as wastewater-positive (n = 47). A secondary sensitivity analysis restricted wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17). Because clinical case surveillance is an imperfect reference standard and does not capture all infections, TP/FP/TN/FN classifications should be interpreted as concordance with reported cases rather than true infection status. All analyses were conducted in R version 4.2.3 (The R Project for Statistical Computing, https://www.r-project.org). During October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, a total of 801 wastewater samples were collected across 16 WWTPs serving an estimated population of ≈2 million people. Of those, 47 (5.9%) were classified as wastewater-positive (17 above the LOD and 30 trace detections) and 754 (94.1%) were wastewater-negative. During the same period, 45 confirmed mpox cases were reported that fell within sewersheds representing the WWTPs in this study. Using a +17-day temporal alignment window, we classified 15 wastewater observations as TPs, 32 as FPs, 627 as TNs, and 127 as FNs (Table 2). The overall sensitivity of wastewater detection identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned reported mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%). Specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%). The PPV was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and the NPV was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). At the WWTP sewershed level, sensitivity was highest at Charlotte WWTP 2 (25.0%) and ranged from 0% to 25.0% across sites with clinical activity (Table 3). Several sewersheds had no temporally aligned clinical cases during the surveillance period, resulting in undefined sensitivity estimates. Specificity was consistently high across sites, ranging from 71.4% to 100%. PPV varied widely by facility, ranging from <1% to 100%, reflecting differences in case occurrence and sampling frequency. NPV exceeded 69% at all sites with clinical activity and was 100% at several facilities without aligned cases. When restricting wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17), sensitivity decreased from 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%) to 1.4% (95% CI 0.4%–5.0%), and specificity increased from 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%) to 97.7% (95% CI 96.3%–98.6%) (Table 2). The number of FP observations decreased from 32 to 15, whereas FN observations increased from 127 to 140. PPV decreased from 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%) to 11.8% (95% CI 3.3%–34.3%), and NPV was similar (83.2% vs. 82.1%). Site-level performance patterns were unchanged. This evaluation assessed the performance of wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV across 16 WWTPs in North Carolina during October 2023–May 2025. Using a +17-day alignment window, wastewater detection demonstrated low sensitivity for identifying temporally aligned clinical cases (10.6% overall when including trace detections and 1.4% when restricted to detections above the LOD) but high specificity (>95%) and moderate NPV of ≈83%. We selected a +17-day window to account for the expected duration of MPXV shedding and potential delays between symptom onset, clinical diagnosis, and case reporting, while also accommodating once-weekly wastewater sampling. Because wastewater represents a composite, time-integrated signal and samples are collected weekly, this window reduces misclassification that could arise from temporal offsets between individual infections and wastewater detection. Those findings compare with national estimates reported in another study (16) that observed a daily sensitivity of 13.8% for detecting >1 person shedding MPXV and a weekly sensitivity of 31.7%. The lower sensitivity observed in North Carolina likely reflects differences in analytic approach, case density, and assumptions about viral shedding. Adams et al. (16) assumed complete case ascertainment and uniform 25-day viral shedding after symptom onset of mpox, whereas our analysis relied on confirmed case onset dates and a fixed +17-day temporal alignment window. This approach likely provides a more conservative estimate of sensitivity because wastewater detections occurring outside the defined window were classified as discordant even if they reflected prolonged or presymptomatic shedding. In addition, only 45 cases were identified across a population of >2 million persons, limiting the probability that wastewater concentrations would exceed detection thresholds. Despite low sensitivity for detecting single cases, specificity was high (95%–98%), indicating that wastewater-negative observations were generally concordant with the absence of reported cases. The NPV exceeded 80% overall and was higher at several individual sites, suggesting that the absence of a wastewater detection was associated with a low likelihood of concurrent reported cases. However, the PPV was modest (31.9% in the primary analysis and 11.8% in the LOD-only analysis), reflecting that some wastewater detections occurred without temporally aligned reported cases. Such detections could represent travel-associated cases, delayed reporting, prolonged shedding, asymptomatic or subclinical infections, or infections among persons residing outside the mapped catchment area. As a consequence, wastewater detections occurring without temporally aligned reported cases should not necessarily be interpreted as analytical FPs and might indicate true but unrecognized infections, suggesting that PPV might be underestimated. Therefore, if even a subset of those observations represented true infections, the PPV of wastewater surveillance would be higher than estimated in this analysis. Of note, sensitivity increased substantially when trace detections were included, indicating that low-level signals contributed meaningfully to temporal concordance with reported cases. That finding underscores the tradeoff between sensitivity and specificity when defining wastewater-positive thresholds. Restricting classification to concentrations above the assay LOD generally increased specificity but markedly reduced sensitivity, potentially limiting early warning capacity in low-incidence settings. In North Carolina, trace detections are interpreted within a structured public health decision framework rather than as definitive evidence of transmission and might prompt notification of local health departments and wastewater partners, review of recent case activity, enhanced syndromic surveillance monitoring, and coordination regarding case investigation or specimen retesting. Those actions are consistent with our public health action decision tree for confirmed detections (Figure). Confirmed detections might also involve escalation actions such as broader public notification, targeted outreach, and intensified sampling. Several factors likely contributed to the low sensitivity observed. First, mpox incidence during the study period was low and sporadic, reducing the probability that viral shedding might be detectable within large, pooled wastewater catchments. Second, sampling occurred once per week, which might have missed transient shedding signals. Third, wastewater represents an aggregate population-level signal, and the dilution effect within large catchments (some serving >500,000 persons) might limit detection of individual infections. Fourth, alignment relied on residential address assignment; persons infected but not residing within the sewershed would reduce measured concordance. The first limitation of this study is that reported clinical cases are not a perfect standard for infection. Our intent was to quantify the extent to which wastewater detections were temporally aligned with reported clinical cases within the same sewershed, rather than to provide an estimate of the true diagnostic accuracy of wastewater surveillance for detecting infection. analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated monkeypox virus (MPXV) surveillance in wastewater across 16 treatment plants in North Carolina, USA, from October 2023 to May 2025, analyzing 801 samples. Using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test, viral gene copies were quantified and normalized to flow rate and population. The assay’s theoretical limit of detection was 500 copies/L, and a +17-day alignment window assessed temporal concordance with 45 reported clinical cases. Wastewater detection showed low sensitivity (10.6% overall; 1.4% above LOD) but high specificity (>95%) and moderate negative predictive value (~83%). Sensitivity increased when trace detections were included, suggesting low-level signals contribute to temporal alignment. The authors conclude that wastewater surveillance complements clinical reporting by providing high specificity and negative predictive value, though sensitivity remains limited for early warning.

source_body_en: We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Early work demonstrated that viral shedding through urine, feces, respiratory secretions, and skin lesions can result in detectable MPXV in wastewater, supporting wastewater-based epidemiology as a viable approach for monitoring and quantifying community transmission (2,7,8). In 1 study, MPXV detections in wastewater were shown to precede the identification of the clinical cases, highlighting its potential for early outbreak detection (9). Another study reported increases in wastewater viral concentrations ahead of reported clinical cases (5). To evaluate mpox wastewater surveillance program in North Carolina, we conducted this study to estimate sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) relative to confirmed clinical cases. Study Area and Surveillance Period We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance analysis to evaluate wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV circulation in North Carolina. The study included data from 16 publicly owned wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) with defined catchment areas serving a combined population of 2,002,864 persons (Table 1).
